text:
mira: kicking off a short sync on the routing blueprint + launch asks — want to lock launch criteria for multi-region + tenant isolation by EOW

sam: +1, can we start with a short list of must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

jordan: must-haves: region failover, SLA bump for reserved customers, routing policy precedence table, simple evict/soft-evict playbook

liam: nice-to-have: per-customer affinity tuning UI and historical routing heatmaps (could be a Q3 deliverable) :eyes:

tanvi: question: do we treat Dedicated and Private the same for isolation requirements? some customers expect stronger eviction guarantees for Dedicated

mira: good Q — proposal: Dedicated = SLA-backed isolation (hard eviction thresholds), Private = customizable (customer-managed) but we need a baseline policy in the console

sam: needs a clear acceptance test. I propose the launch criteria include: documented policy matrix + canary run with 3 tenants, SLA observable in console, rollback path defined

jordan: also add cost guardrails: model-aware routing must not increase token cost > 10% for default config. Otherwise finance will veto

liam: ops concern: autoscale spike from cross-region failover can double throughput for short bursts — we need burst bandwidth caps and routing throttles

tanvi: customer asks: two mid-market customers want control plane hooks for policy overrides (webhook API) — can we scope as an opt-in beta?

mira: agree on opt-in beta. Action items:
- jordan to draft policy precedence table (due Thu)
- sam to write acceptance test checklist (due Thu)
- liam to propose throttling + burst caps (due Fri)
- tanvi to collect customer override API requirements (due Fri)

sam: can we add a short command snippet for canary so oncall can run it?

liam: sure, quick example:
```
# canary: route 10% of tenant traffic to new-policy
POST /admin/routing/canary
{ "tenant": "example-tenant", "pct": 10, "policy": "isolation-v2" }
```

mira: nice. Also need rollout guardrails: automatic rollback on latency regression > 15% or error rate > 3% over 5m

jordan: noted. I'll include telemetry metrics and dashboard wires in the policy doc

tanvi: customer-facing doc needed: what happens when their tenant gets soft-evicted? include timeline and compensation expectations

mira: ok wrapping — goal: ship policy docs + acceptance tests by EOW, alpha canary next week. Ping me if you need to re-negotiate deadlines. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window created for 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC (ID: canary-215666)
